description_full: Conduit Holdings Limited, through its subsidiary, provides reinsurance products and services in the United States, Europe, and worldwide. It operates in three divisions: Property, Casualty, and Specialty. The company offers property catastrophe and non-catastrophe reinsurance products; directors and officers, financial institutions, general, professional, including other errors and omissions, and transactional liability, as well as medical malpractice reinsurance products. It also provides aviation, contingency, energy, engineering and construction, environmental, marine, renewables, political violence and terrorism, whole account, as well as species and fine art, war, and event capped QS of above xl lines reinsurance products. Conduit Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2020 and is headquartered in Pembroke, Bermuda.

financial_summary: CONDUIT HLDGS LTD is a small-cap financial services business with a $822M market cap on $836M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +36% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.

The business throws off $362M in free cash flow — roughly 43 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 3.10× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year.

Management returns a meaningful 9.1% of market cap to owners through dividends and buybacks, a strong signal of disciplined capital allocation, and insiders hold 18% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is.
